text_3:
Graduate teaching assistant
UNLV · Since Fall 2024
text_4: As a graduate teaching assistant, I design and lead discussion sessions, grade assignments, and support undergraduate students across multiple sections. My teaching emphasizes conceptual clarity, real-world application, and statistical reasoning. Discussion sections typically include approximately 25 students.
text_5: Assignments are in a graduate assistant / teaching assistant capacity, including discussion instruction and student support.
text_8: I help students move beyond memorizing formulas toward understanding the reasoning behind mathematical and statistical ideas. I encourage questions, connect concepts to applications, and help students build confidence with unfamiliar problems.
text_9: In statistics, I emphasize critical thinking about data, assumptions, uncertainty, and evidence. In mathematics, I connect conceptual understanding with problem-solving skills so students understand both how a method works and why it works.
text_10: I aim to create a supportive, inclusive environment where students can ask questions, learn from mistakes, and develop their own approaches. My goal is to cultivate independent thinking, quantitative reasoning, and intellectual curiosity.
